_comment: Owner-only envelopes (owner gate, 2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): licence-derived reads answer the OWNER_EMAILS accounts alone, so this spec runs with --auth-cookie of an owner session (a --auth-signup user is not an owner and gets 403 owner_only, which auth-gated.json asserts). The three entries are the SEC-1 scan envelopes from auth-gated.json, moved unchanged. Environment-independent: rows may be [] and sweep null on a fresh or pre-worker boot, and samples may be [] on a cold store. To get an owner session locally: boot the API with OWNER_EMAILS naming an account (e.g. the AUTH_DEMO_SEED one), POST /api/auth/login, and pass its gf_session cookie as NAME=VALUE.

endpoints._note: SEC-1 (2026-10-26): a signed-in read, since its rows carry dealer levels derived from the licensed options feed; signed out is the 403 public-surface.json asserts. Envelope only: rows may be [] and sweep null on a fresh or pre-worker boot.
SEC-1 (2026-10-26): the whole universe ranked by score, signed in only. Envelope only, as scan_default_view_signed_in.
SEC-1 (2026-10-26): each sample carries the flip, the walls and net GEX, so the structure path is signed in only. samples may be [] on a cold store.
